name: Basilica of Saint John the Baptist
history: St. John the Baptist, established in 1823, is called the oldest Catholic parish in northeastern Ohio. Its church was designed by James Renwick Jr. and completed in 1871, then dedicated in 1872. It was named a minor basilica on 19 June 2012.
arch: Red-brick Gothic Revival by James Renwick Jr., with a tall central spire and white stone trim.
features: It houses a 79-rank pipe organ built by Kegg Pipe Organ Builders of nearby Hartville, Ohio.
Bishop George V. Murry of Youngstown celebrated the basilica Mass in 2012.

look.d: The same architect designed St. Patrick's Cathedral in New York.
The parish dates to 1823, when Canton was a frontier town.

fun: Its architect, James Renwick Jr., also designed St. Patrick's Cathedral in Manhattan and the Smithsonian Castle.
journal: Renwick Gothic in Canton. The parish is older than most of the state's railroads.

quiz.q: How many ranks does its pipe organ have?
